description: Fetch one ad in full: copy, creative caption, duplication facts, its destination landing page, and presigned media URLs you can pull into context to look at the creative itself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_ad
title: Get ad
